description: This HTML file structures a web-based database viewer interface, including styles, layout, and embedded JavaScript for dynamic data fetching and UI interaction.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, updating UI and resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's table list in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and renders it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds an HTML table to display the data records.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content with proper handling of nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content, especially for large text or objects.
